_meta.source: Illustrative example of a rubric v2.4 scorecard. Criteria, tiers, and thresholds mirror scripts/calibration_verdict.py (RUBRIC_VERSION 2.4, CRITERIA at lines 344-357); numbers are faithful in proportion but are NOT raw solver output and do not describe any registered run.
_meta.description: One ISO-year C1-C8 tiered scorecard for the calibration-rubric narrative page. Each row: criterion id, name, tier (load-bearing / supporting / protective), actual vs modeled value, the coded threshold, and the scored status. Statuses mix PASS / CAVEAT / GROUNDED / SKIP to illustrate the full vocabulary. actual/modeled are null where the criterion scores a derived statistic or a gate rather than an actual-vs-model pair.

run_metadata.note: Synthetic single-year excerpt; real keepers score all bundle years 2023-2025 together.

rows.name: Fuel-mix by class, grid-delivered
rows.threshold: |model-actual| <= min(2.0% ISO load, 8 TWh) AND share within +/-3.0 pp
rows.note: Worst-class delta 5.8 TWh, share delta +0.7 pp; all classes in band.

rows.name: Gas/coal family system volume
rows.threshold: Prelim-923 fallback vs EIA-930: target +/-2.5%, commercial +/-5%; immaterial < 10 TWh
rows.note: Delta +3.2% misses the target band but sits inside the commercial band (two-band caveat, unbudgeted). Complete 2024 EIA-923 vintage would defer this row to C1.

rows.name: Mean LMP
rows.threshold: +/-10% passes clean (target == commercial as of v2.3)

rows.name: Monthly price shape (NRMSE)
rows.note: Scored on load-weighted actual monthly means (v2.4); the statistic is model-vs-actual by construction, so no separate actual column.

rows.name: Scarcity tail, DA-expressible
rows.threshold: Model within [0.5x, 2.0x] of DA actual; if actual < 10 h, |model-actual| <= 10
rows.note: Ratio 0.43 falls below the 0.5x band floor: the model under-forms the scarcity tail. Supporting-tier caveat, counts against the ledgered budget.

rows.name: Fleet hourly dispatch correlation
rows.threshold: r >= 0.70 AND NRMSE <= 0.30 (gas, coal); skip fleet < 5 TWh
rows.note: Gas r=0.84 / NRMSE 0.22; coal r=0.78 / NRMSE 0.26.

rows.name: Storage dispatch shape (monthly discharge r)
rows.note: Actual monthly discharge CV 0.18 < 0.25 - too flat a seasonal shape to score a correlation; row skipped, not caveated.

rows.name: Governance gate
rows.threshold: 4 attestation assertions + machine-clean outage source; UNATTESTED -> NOT-YET
rows.note: Attestation complete: DOF ledger present, ablation twin linked, outage source machine-clean.

rows.name: Diurnal shape (D-1)
rows.units: worst material class profile r; off-peak CV ratio 0.63
rows.threshold: profile r >= 0.8 AND off-peak CV ratio >= 0.5; gated only if class >= 2% load
rows.note: All material classes clear both gates; sub-2%-load classes reported by D-1 but not gated.

rows.name: Forced-energy share (D-2)
rows.units: % of class energy at binding floors (CT peaker; cap shown as actual)
rows.threshold: < 15% peaker / < 30% merchant; >= 2%-load materiality; above-cap -> grounded escalation
rows.note: CT-peaker forced share 18.2% exceeds the 15% cap, but every binding mechanism carries a passing D-4 driver window AND the class clears the D-1 shape gates - grounded-above-budget escalation (v2.2): clean PASS surfaced as a report note, never a caveat.

determination.note: C6 passes and no criterion FAILs; one ledgered caveat (C3c) within budget, one unbudgeted commercial-band caveat (C2), one skip (C5c), one grounded note (C8).
